description: In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.
